description: Unique identifier for each source document in the corpus (e.g., DOC001, DOC002). Multiple chunks can share the same doc_id.

Format/type of the source document from which the chunk was extracted. Values include: TXT (plain text), PDF (Portable Document Format), HTML (web page), Word (Microsoft Word), Markdown (Markdown format).
Unique identifier for each text chunk created during document splitting (e.g., CHK00001). Each chunk_id maps to one specific text segment.
Number of words in the text chunk. Reflects chunk size after splitting. Range: 50–499, Mean: 269.
Cosine similarity score between the query embedding and the chunk embedding during retrieval. Range: 0.0 (no similarity) to 1.0 (identical). Mean: 0.7466.
Category of the user query that retrieved this chunk. Values: factual (fact lookup), analytical (analysis/reasoning), comparative (comparison), procedural (how-to), summarization (summary request).
Quality score of the generated answer using the retrieved chunk as context. Range: 0.0 (poor) to 1.0 (excellent). Mean: 0.8029.
